items.headline: King Copper reports ~7,170 ha of additional contiguous concessions at Colquemayo.
items.why_it_matters: The new ground materially enlarges the district-scale search space around an emerging Cu system. The company says staking followed review of historic data and satellite imagery and cites Au-Cu-Mo geochemical anomalies; these are company-reported exploration indicators, not a discovery.

items.headline: DLP reports permits for the first-ever drill program at Esperanza.
items.why_it_matters: A previously undrilled, district-scale target is moving from surface/geophysical targeting to direct subsurface testing. The planned program combines shallow testing of an oxide zone with deep holes into an interpreted porphyry target.
items.source_name: DLP Resources Inc. release via Newsfile

items.headline: Coppernico contracts a minimum 5,000 m Phase 2 diamond drill program at Sombrero.
items.why_it_matters: The project is preparing a new drill cycle in an underexplored Cu-Au district. Mobilization remains conditional on final start-of-activities authorization, so this is a program catalyst rather than a completed exploration result.

items.headline: Capstone completes acquisition of the San Pietro copper concessions in Chile.
items.why_it_matters: The transaction consolidates additional underexplored ground and mineral inventory inside the Mantoverde–Santo Domingo district, illustrating continued district-scale consolidation around existing and planned infrastructure.
